fresh_market_evidence.observation: Published x402 pricing and live-quote verification are increasingly commoditized; provider-weighted median is approximately USD 0.01/call and only a subset of catalogued routes prove payable when probed.
fresh_market_evidence.implication: Do not sell discovery, catalogue pricing, or unpaid 402 health as the core product.

fresh_market_evidence.observation: Competitor infrastructure now publishes uptime, p95 latency, conformance, price, on-chain settlements and unique-buyer traction, while explicitly noting that unpaid 402 handshake health does not prove post-payment success.
fresh_market_evidence.implication: Generic reliability, latency, compliance, settlement and traction scoring are insufficient differentiation.

fresh_market_evidence.observation: Outcome-level workflow cost benchmarking exists for model/workflow token economics.
fresh_market_evidence.implication: James must remain focused on machine-service purchasing decisions using identical executable tasks and observed paid outcomes rather than generic workflow cost estimation.

surviving_product_claim: For an identical deterministic machine task, measure actual settled spend, retries, paid latency and acceptable-result PASS/FAIL to estimate effective cost per acceptable result.
kill_trigger: Stop and reassess if a credible competitor exposes the same identical-task benchmark with deterministic acceptance, actual settled spend, retries and effective cost per acceptable result as a purchasable/routable service.
commercial_implication: Post-approval positioning must lead with outcome-adjusted purchasing economics, not cheapest API, directory coverage, uptime, x402 compliance or raw settlement volume.
launch_control: No customer payment or promised delivery until independent Relay/QA records APPROVED_FOR_LIMITED_PILOT.
